date.as_written: śaravāṇarṣibhūvarṣe || 1755 || bhādre śukle ... caturthyāṃ ... saṃ 1755 bhādra śu 4 caṃdre

notes: Chronogram śara (5) - vāṇa (5) - ṛṣi (7) - bhū (1) yields 1755, confirmed by the numeric notation 1755 and catalogued under the Śaka era (ŚS 1755). The abbreviation 'li.i.' at the end likely stands for 'likhitaṃ indreṇa'.
